item.title: Japanese Woodblock Print Search
item.description:

item.title: A Botnet Accidentally Destroyed I2P
item.description:
📝 On February 3, 2026, the I2P anonymity network was flooded with 700,000 hostile nodes in what became one of the most devastating Sybil attacks an anonymity network has ever experienced. The network normally operates with 15,000 to 20,000 active devices. For three consecutive years, I2P has been hit with Sybil attacks every February.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sambent.com/a-botnet-accidentally-destroyed-i2p-the-full-story/
